text:
Type: mini concrete planters, set of three
Use: holding succulents or air plants; on a desk, shelf or windowsill in a living room, home office, bedroom
Style: industrial, minimalist, modern
Materials: textured cast concrete, painted rim
Colors: light warm grey, white, blush, pale blue
Shape: low round puck with a center well and diamond-crosshatch sides, very small and squat
Feel: tactile, soft, playful
Goes with: white desks, pastel accents, succulents; modern or industrial rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Urban Concrete Circular Blue Gold White Planters
product.description: Crosshatch markes decorate the sides of these one-of-a-kind planters. Designed for succulents and air plants, these planters are perfect to decorate a table or window sill. Each planter is handmade by a local artist in northeast Indiana. 4.5" Diameter x 1.5"H Designed for small succulents and air plants Felt pads underneath prevent scratching surfaces Made by hand in the United States No additional drip tray required as the bottom is solid Since each piece is handmade expect variations
